title: Metabolic FCH micelles from noise: a shell-held autocatalyst turns a fed precursor into the body's own amphiphile; bodies divide, and die within ~600 t when the precursor is cut (SIBWDE, fch-bilayer)
summary: The gated-micelle world with its amphiphile feed removed: amphiphile u is made only where a catalyst c meets a fed precursor p inside a body (ks c p (u+0.6)_+) and degrades everywhere (kdeg=0.005); c replicates on p inside bodies and decays outside; a self-made shell q adsorbed at the body surface gates c (D e^{-8q}). From white noise u and a uniform random catalyst, ~27 micelles form by t~200, fill with catalyst (10x rising to ~900x the outside) and divide 34-40 times per seed (generation 3, 0 merges), depleting the precursor around them; the population levels off at ~73 bodies by t~1900 (precursor-limited). Fork at t=400, same seed: with the precursor supply cut, the bodies shrink and all die (46/46 and 41/41 by t~1000), while in the fed twin 46/46 and 40/41 founder lineages live and multiply to 69 and 64. Ablations from t=0 (seed 0): no catalyst replication (kc=0), no gate (beta=0) or no adsorbed shell layer (chi_q=0) each leave 0 bodies by t~500, so the shell does work: without it the catalyst leaks out and the bodies starve.

claims.statement: On seeds 0 and 1, micelles that form from noise carry a self-made shell ring and hold a self-made autocatalyst inside it (10-900x the outside), make their own amphiphile from the fed precursor, grow and divide (34-40 persistent splits, generation 3, no merges); when the precursor supply is cut at t=400 every body dies within ~600 t while the same bodies in the fed twin live and multiply; removing the shell layer or its gate kills every body.
claims.track: seed 0, the body in row 3 of fission_strips_seed0.png (t=316-372): shell ring and catalyst ~170x, elongates and divides into two ringed daughters that keep catalyst (~60-230x) and live on in the fed run

controls_run.E: pack_cut400/ (seeds 0, 1: precursor feed F=0 from t=400, branched from the fed run: 46/46 and 41/41 bodies dead by t~1000 vs 46/46 and 40/41 alive in pack/; numbers.txt) and pack_kc0/ (no catalyst replication: 0 bodies by t~500)
controls_run.W: pack_beta0/ (gate off: the catalyst is not held and every body dies by t~490) and pack_res15/ (1.5x finer grid, dx 0.333: 32 -> 69 bodies, 21 persistent splits, catalyst 35-180x with 96-100% of bodies >= 2x, shell ring 260/260 individuals; numbers.txt)
controls_run.B: pack_chiq0/ (q made but not adsorbed, no ring: every body dies by t~490)

claims.bd_control: not run as a Laplacian twin; beta=0 (catalyst by plain diffusion through identical bodies) is the matched control for containment.

limits: Part of the dependence on the resource is built in: the body's amphiphile degrades at a fixed rate and can be rebuilt only from the precursor, so a reviewer may record E as by construction; what is not built in is that the bodies must hold their catalyst with their own shell to persist (beta=0 and chi_q=0 kill them). Catalyst leaks at every fission (parent ~250x, daughters ~20x right after) and a few bodies carry almost none (weakest body 0-0.3x late in the run). No intrinsic turnover once the precursor is shared out: the population saturates at ~73 with 0-1 deaths per run. eta terms O(1); one parameter point (ks=0.03, kdeg=0.005).
